title: JobVocabulary
shortDescription: Learn practical words for work and everyday life with fast, simple exercises.
fullDescription:
Learn the language you need at work and in everyday life.

JobVocabulary offers 47 courses with practical words and phrases. Explore jobs such as cleaning, restaurants, hotels, warehouses, construction and care, or everyday topics including transport, time and numbers.

Choose a language and a course, then start your first task. Danish, English, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Romanian, Lithuanian and Bulgarian are available as learning and support languages.

• Practise with multiple choice, writing and other task types.
• Mix task types and choose your level.
• Get immediate feedback and learn at your own pace.
• Save favourite words and create your own word lists.
• Review words at intervals adapted to your answers.
• Hear words when your device supports a voice for the language.

The app is free and requires no account. Progress and word lists are stored locally in your device's browser. There is no cross-device sync. An internet connection is required. Read-aloud depends on the voices available in your browser and operating system.

JobVocabulary is for people aged 16 and over. Courses provide language practice and do not replace vocational training, an official examination or individual advice.

Questions and suggestions: contact@jobvocabulary.com
